description: You are the ITSM Administrator at a research university. The Research Computing Services department has been onboarded and needs its own IT support structure in the service desk. Your tasks: (1) Create a new Department named 'Research Computing Services' in the system. (2) Create a new top-level Service Category named 'Research Computing' for classifying research-related IT requests. (3) Under the 'Research Computing' category, create three subcategories: 'HPC Cluster Access', 'Research Data Storage', and 'Scientific Software'. (4) Create a new Technician Group named 'Research Computing Support Team'. (5) Create a new Request Template named 'HPC Cluster Access Request' that uses the 'Research Computing' category and 'HPC Cluster Access' subcategory, so researchers can submit standardized requests. Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
